summary: Nora can use a clip or a voice note sent in the chat as a reference for a video she makes: a clip for its motion, a voice note for its voice.
details: Each kind is switched on by itself: `[video_gen] allow_reference_video` and `allow_reference_audio`, both off by default.

Every clip and sound is fitted before it is sent: cut to `[video_gen] reference_seconds` (default 6), cropped, scaled, set to 24 to 30 frames a second, and re-encoded, so a screen recording or a voice note in any format works.
A clip or voice note under 2 seconds is refused before anything is spent, and she says why.
limitations: A reference clip's seconds are billed by the provider on top of the clip's own; audio was not billed when measured.
Only the first seconds of each reference are used.
A clip or voice note cannot be the first frame.
